item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】ALAC - Céline Dion - Dolby Atmos Greatest Hits Playlist [E-AC3-JOC | 5.1 | 16bit/48kHz] [WAV | 5.1 | 24bit/48kHz]
item.description:
Cèline Dion Playlist Collection of her Greatest Hits. I have test a lot of Céline Dion songs in FLAC and WAV Format, Original CDs and Vinyl Rips. They were all have bad qualities and its the Producer's Decision to keep the Clipping & Distortions in Her songs. I've figured that Apple Dolby Atmos Engineer have remixed Céline songs in a Super Clear Resolution, and I wanna share her Hits Songs in M4A and WAV (The Song's Sources are from the Best Qualities Album, not just compressed compilations). Here are the Tracklist:
  • M4A 16bit/48kHz:
  1. A New Day Has Come (Radio Remix) - 4:19
  2. Be the Man (On This Night) [English Version] - 4:39
  3. I Surrender - 04:47
  4. The Power of Love - 05:42
  5. That's the Way It Is - 04:01
  • WAV 24bit/48kHz - Falling Into You:
  1. All By Myself 05:12
  2. Call the Man - 06:08
  3. Because You Loved Me (Theme from "Up Close and Personal") - 4:33
  4. I Love You - 05:30
  5. It's All Coming Back to Me Now - 07:36
  6. Seduces Me - 01:45
